::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/analytics"}
#docs
:::warning
This endpoint is deprecated. It keeps working within its API version.
:::

Deprecated. Replaced by `GET /v1/analytics` and `GET /v1/analytics/measures`, which answer the same figures one measure at a time from the same underlying computation. This endpoint keeps answering with an unchanged payload and will only be removed at a version boundary, announced ahead of time.

Powers the business dashboard. Flow metrics (billing, payments, refunds, credit notes, signups, activations, cancellations) are bucketed by timestamp; stock metrics (MRR, CMRR, active subscriptions) are reconstructed from subscription lifecycle dates. Money is either converted into the business default currency via its manual FX rates (`currency=ALL`) or scoped to one currency.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `range` | `string` | no | 60 days / 13 weeks / 26 weeks / 12 months of buckets |
| `currency` | `string` | no | `ALL` for the FX-converted roll-up, or a currency code to scope every figure to it |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `business_analytics`. One of `business_analytics`. |
| `business` | `string` | The business id. |
| `as_of` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the figures were computed. |
| `range` | `string` | The selected range. One of `daily`, `3m`, `6m`, `12m`. |
| `granularity` | `string` | The bucket size of the series. One of `day`, `week`, `month`. |
| `currency` | `string` | The currency of the money figures. |
| `converted` | `boolean` | True if the figures are converted into `currency`. |
| `available_currencies` | `array of string` | Currencies you can select. |
| `missing_rates` | `array of string` | Currencies that have no exchange rate and are left out. |
| `kpis` | `object` | The headline figures. |
| `windows` | `object` | The calendar windows that the KPIs use. |
| `series` | `array of object` | The metric time-series. |
| `subscriptions_by_plan` | `object` | Subscription count per plan. |
| `mrr_movement_by_plan` | `array of object` | MRR movement per plan. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Business analytics |
| `400` | Invalid range |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/analytics" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
